decision_conditions:
The location plan (the one needed as part of the application is the location plan submitted under PA26/1515, I believe, as the one submitted refers to the whole No. 63). 

sent via email 7/9 (hd)
The address only refers to the first floor of No. 63A, while the application seems to referee to the whole building (if they refer to the whom building a new application form is needed). 

Also, I note that the property has been rented from 2015 to today to Levene as office, but I cannot see a legal agreement running from that date or a sum of legal agreements adding up to demonstrate a rental period from 2015 to today. The agreements (from 2015 to now), if applicable, should be provided in chronological order and clearly named/titled to demonstrate such. These along with the statutory declarations (already provided) are the evidence to be provided to demonstrate the office use.
description: Existing use of the premises as an office falling within Use Class E(g)(i).
